title: Realizing a closed union of affine connected components by a quotient ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $E\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}A$ a Zariski-closed subset which is a union of connected components (maximal connected subsets) of the underlying space [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. There exist a commutative ring $B$ and a surjective ring homomorphism $v:A\to B$ for which $\operatorname{Spec}(v)$ is a homeomorphism from $\operatorname{Spec}B$ onto $E$ with its subspace topology. For every prime $\mathfrak q\subset B$, writing $\mathfrak p=v^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, the induced map $A_{\mathfrak p}\to B_{\mathfrak q}$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].

source.place: Tag 097C, lemma-construct, applied to a closed union of components; Topology Tag 04PL, lemma-closed-union-connected-components, identifies it as an intersection of clopens; Tag 096T, lemma-ind-zariski-implies, gives the induced local-ring isomorphisms

proof.text: Put T = ConnectedComponents.mk(E). If x maps into T, choose y in E with the same connected component. Then x lies in connectedComponent y and hence in E by component saturation. Conversely every point of E maps into T. Thus the inverse image of T is E, and the quotient-topology criterion makes T closed.

proof.text: Use the actual ring B = WContractification.Restriction T and its canonical algebra map v. The restriction surjectivity theorem gives surjectivity of v. The construction and its algebra structure are those already defined in the source library; no witness is chosen from a mere existence theorem.

proof.text: The restriction spectrum-range theorem identifies the range of Spec(v) with the inverse image of T, hence with E. A surjective ring map induces an embedding of spectra by PrimeSpectrum.isEmbedding_comap_of_surjective, the embedding part of the general quotient-spectrum theorem. Its canonical homeomorphism onto its range, followed by Homeomorph.setCongr for this range equality, gives the required homeomorphism onto E. The underlying function is definitionally Spec(v).

source.place: Tag 097C, lemma-construct, applied to a closed union of components; Topology Tag 04PL, lemma-closed-union-connected-components, identifies it as an intersection of clopens; Tag 096T, lemma-ind-zariski-implies, gives the induced local-ring isomorphisms

proof.text: The source-library instance WContractification.Restriction.indZariski already proves that this restriction ring is an ind-Zariski A-algebra: its clopen-neighborhood diagram is filtered, and each idempotent localization is a standard open immersion and hence a local isomorphism. Apply Algebra.IndZariski.bijectiveOnStalks_algebraMap and its localRingHom projection at q.asIdeal. This is exactly the canonical local-ring map in the conclusion, with no transport or change of algebra map.
